signals.text: 1 open PM role across 1 US office

bullets: Define and optimize engagement loops, including push notifications, in-app messaging, and social sharing mechanics.
Lead projects end-to-end, from ideation through launch and iteration.
Partner with engineering and design to deliver intuitive, high-quality mobile experiences across iOS and Android.
Collaborate cross-functionally with growth, marketing, support, data, and creator teams to align on product strategy.
Use data and user insights to identify and anticipate opportunities to improve activation, retention, and engagement
